name: EcoGas
note: Front-of-chest sponsor on FC Orenburg's 2026/27 home shirt per match photos (2 August 2026, CC BY-SA 3.0 via fc-zenit.ru, Wikimedia Commons) and Football Kit Archive's kit listing (which shows 'featuring ECO GAS as the sponsor' in search results; the site 403s scripted requests and was not opened). The legal entity behind the shirt brand is unconfirmed: a fuel brand of the same name (EcoGas) is used at Gazprom-network CNG stations (gmt.gazprom.ru, 'Automobile fuel EcoGas'), but no source found connects the shirt logo to that brand or names a sponsoring company. Ownership therefore not claimed. Leads: the club's partner banners on fcorenburg.ru; Gazprom's CNG-network site gazprom-agnks.ru (footer: ООО «Газпром газомоторное топливо»); the club's Telegram channel t.me/fcorenburg.
